subject: Purchase order acceptance & temporary evidence path for ClearGlobe pilot
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@clearglobe.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@clearglobe.io>, J. Simmons <jsimmons@clearglobe.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — pilot invoices without PO?

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at ClearGlobe is excited to run the 6-week pilot. Our procurement organization has a strict PO-first policy but for early-stage pilots they can accept an invoice-only path if we provide an acceptable set of intake evidence and a provisional payment agreement.

Two quick asks: 1) Can Redwood accept invoices for the pilot (noting we may not be able to issue a PO before the pilot start date)? 2) If so, what exact supporting docs or intake form do you require so Procurement is comfortable paying on invoice?

I've attached our internal purchase intake to this email for context (attached: clearglobe_vendor_intake_form.pdf). If it helps, procurement is happy to loop in a contact to confirm the minimum evidence required.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships, ClearGlobe
elena@clearglobe.io

Attachment: clearglobe_vendor_intake_form.pdf (application/pdf, 78 KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearglobe.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — pilot invoices without PO?

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and glad the demo landed. Short answer: we can support a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots, but Procurement needs a small standard package of evidence and an approval from Redwood Procurement.

Minimum evidence we usually ask for (pilot invoice path):
- Completed vendor intake form (we have yours)
- Valid tax form (W9 for US vendors)
- Point of contact + billing email
- Maximum pilot spend cap agreed in writing (we typically ask for $5k or lower without a PO)
- Provisional payment agreement signed by both parties (covers payment timing and dispute escalation)

If you can send W9 and confirm the pilot cap, I will start the exception workflow with our Procurement team. Marissa — FYI this is a standard sales-led pilot request. Karthik — looping you for formal approval steps.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena@clearglobe.io>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — pilot invoices without PO?

Thanks Naomi — happy to help. Elena, to speed things up we can accept invoice-only for the six-week pilot if ClearGlobe agrees to: 1) pilot spend cap of $4,750, 2) Redwood issues a single invoice per month, and 3) ClearGlobe provides a W9 and payment contact. We can also offer the first month pro-rated credit if procurement needs extra justification internally.

If you want, I can draft the provisional payment agreement language and share a DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena@clearglobe.io>, Procurement Ops <procure@clearglobe.io>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval conditions for invoice-only pilot (ClearGlobe)

Thanks for the context. Procurement will approve a temporary no-PO onboarding for this pilot under the following conditions:
- Pilot cap must be $5,000 USD or less (we can approve up to $5k administratively)
- Vendor must be added to our vendor registry with W9 attached
- Finance must receive an executed provisional payment agreement that sets payment terms (NET30) and identifies billing contact
- ClearGlobe must acknowledge Redwood's audit right for pilot activity (standard clause)

Please confirm back once the W9 and signed provisional agreement are in place and we'll mark the vendor active for invoice-only billing. I've attached the internal checklist we use (not attached here).

Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Hi all — thanks, that path works for us. Attached: W9_CG_Executed.pdf and a signed provisional-payment-agreement.docx (signed by our CFO). We agree to the $4,750 cap and NET30 terms. Billing contact will be accounts@clearglobe.io.

Forwarding the signed agreement and W9 in case you need to route them internally. Please let us know once Redwood marks ClearGlobe active so we can schedule the pilot start next week.
